name: record-access-with-index-test-496b8706b7/record-access-with-index-e.bal
spec_references: Statements: [Assignment] — See supported lvexpr; [Local variable declarations]
reason: The case checks compile-time record indexing diagnostics: undeclared variables and fields, integer or mixed string/integer indices, incompatible result assignment, and finite string indices with no field intersection on closed records. It also expects a valid finite string index on an open record to compile. These are supported member-access, assignment, declaration, record/type-definition and literal constructs; the subset specifies no restriction excluding their static type checks or finite index unions.
test_design_notes: Negative compilation case; @error comments mark expected rejection, while the unmarked foo[f3] access is expected to be accepted. Illegal indices and unresolved references test supported static checking rather than introducing unsupported features.
